trigger.failure: final product ELF identity drift with identical source, headers, flags and toolchain
trigger.repeated_reproduction: Eight retained-clone final links alternated between the two code shapes; this was real whole-program allocation nondeterminism, not ELF metadata drift.

root_cause.mechanism: LLVM-MOS was free to preserve the installer context and copy-target pointers either in zero page or in anonymous .noinit storage across memcpy and CRC calls.
root_cause.effect: The choice changed the installer by six bytes, shifted the following image, and changed the complete product ELF despite identical inputs.
root_cause.prior_gate_limit: Binding the packed runtime-overlay bank to one final ELF proved package consistency but could not make that final ELF reproducible.

structural_fix.implementation: The boot installer now uses the two already-existing runtime call slots for its context and target. Installer accesses use volatile lvalues so both cross-call values are reloaded from named storage; the resident batch path retains its original non-volatile code shape.
structural_fix.lifetime_proof: Installation finishes before the resident island becomes ready; batch execution requires the ready state. Installer and batch use of the shared slots cannot overlap.
structural_fix.permanent_gate: workbench-runtime-overlay-package-verify requires rtov_call_context and rejects every final product ELF whose __lisp65_workbench_noinit_end differs from __bss_end.
structural_fix.failure_class_closed: The allocator can no longer invent anonymous cross-call storage for either installer pointer.

verification.gate_negative_proof: A context-only intermediate fix still allowed the copy target to spill into two anonymous .noinit bytes; the new structural gate rejected that real product link before the target slot was bound explicitly.

exact_relinks.environment: same final generated bindings, forced complete final relink each time

verification.final_overlay_binding: PASS: all 44 final-ELF slices exactly match the 65472-byte packed image and manifest
verification.fresh_clone_varied_double_build: required after commit before R3 promotion

claim_limit: This diagnosis proves the local structural allocation fix, the zero-anonymous-spill gate, eight exact final relinks, unchanged behavior in the runtime-overlay host matrix and a 22-byte installer-slice headroom credit. It does not replace the canonical varied fresh-clone double build, promote a product set, or claim R3/R4/R5/R6/G5/G6 acceptance.
